stories.title: FGR identifica al dueño del vehículo usado para huir tras asesinato del periodista Alejandro Leyva; hermano del periodista denuncia falta de avances

en.title: FGR identifies owner of vehicle used to flee after murder of journalist Alejandro Leyva; journalist's brother reports lack of progress
en.summary: Mexican authorities have identified the owner of a vehicle used in the escape following the July 22, 2026 murder of Oaxacan journalist Alejandro Leyva. The victim's brother has expressed concerns about the pace of the investigation.

stories.title: Muere motociclista tras derrapar en puente de Pantitlán; autoridades investigan las causas

en.title: Motorcyclist dies after skidding on Pantitlán bridge; authorities investigate causes
en.summary: A motorcyclist died after losing control on a bridge in Pantitlán. Emergency personnel arrived at the scene to find the rider on the bridge's upper section.

stories.title: Brugada busca replicar en CDMX buenas prácticas de NY para apoyar a repartidores; plantea espacios de descanso y baños

en.title: Brugada seeks to replicate New York best practices in Mexico City to support delivery workers; proposes rest areas and bathrooms
en.summary: Mexico City's government head discussed adopting practices from New York to assist delivery workers, including establishing rest spaces and bathroom facilities. The capital emphasized strengthening multilateral cooperation between cities.

stories.title: Comparecen 13 detenidos por ataque armado en Las Granjas que dejó tres muertos; podrían alcanzar hasta 180 años de prisión

en.title: 13 detainees appear in court for armed attack in Las Granjas that left three dead; could face up to 180 years in prison
en.summary: Thirteen suspects appeared in proceedings related to an armed attack in Las Granjas that killed three people. Federal, state, and municipal security forces have conducted operations in the northern eastern zone of Tuxtla Gutiérrez.

stories.title: Aeroméxico atribuye presunta filtración de datos en Telegram a incidente de ciberseguridad de 2025

en.title: Aeroméxico attributes alleged data leak on Telegram to 2025 cybersecurity incident
en.summary: Aeroméxico stated that a data incident circulated over the weekend did not impact its technological infrastructure, operations, or services.

en.title: Hurricane 'Polo' intensifies to category 2
en.summary: Hurricane Polo strengthened to category 2 with maximum sustained winds of 175 km/h, located 310 km south-southwest of Zihuatanejo.

stories.title: Afirma Aeroméxico que no hubo robo de datos bancarios

en.title: Aeroméxico states no bank data was stolen
en.summary: Aeroméxico claimed that a database offered for sale on Telegram does not contain users' banking information.

stories.title: Aeroméxico afirma que hackeo no involucra datos bancarios; información habría sido sustraída en 2025

en.title: Aeroméxico states hack does not involve banking data; information allegedly extracted in 2025
en.summary: Aeroméxico indicated the compromised data may originate from an October 2025 incident and includes names, emails, phone numbers, and in some cases birth dates.

stories.title: Esfuerzos para congelar el diésel en 27 pesos por litro podrían costar 308 millones de pesos al día

en.title: Efforts to freeze diesel at 27 pesos per liter could cost 308 million pesos daily
en.summary: Maintaining diesel prices frozen at 27 pesos per liter could cost Mexico 308 million pesos daily in fiscal expenses. An energy specialist warns that if international prices rise, the country could spend billions of pesos monthly to sustain this price control.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica a categoría 2; EN VIVO, últimas noticias del ciclón

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies to category 2; LIVE, latest news on the cyclone
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has intensified to category 2 and is moving eastward at 7 km/h. The system maintains a surveillance zone spanning from Tecpan de Galeana in Guerrero to Punta San Telmo in Michoacán.

stories.title: 8 recipientes de vidrio EasyWare por 430 pesos en Amazon; una opción práctica para guardar, congelar y recalentar comida

en.title: 8 EasyWare glass containers for 430 pesos on Amazon; a practical option for storing, freezing and reheating food
en.summary: An EasyWare glass container set is offered on Amazon for 430 pesos. The 16-piece set allows for food storage, freezing, reheating, and can be used directly in the oven.

stories.title: Investigan presunto robo de datos de clientes de Aeroméxico

en.title: Investigation into alleged data theft from Aeroméxico customers
en.summary: Mexico's anti-corruption agency opened an investigation into a suspected data breach affecting Aeroméxico, involving over 15 million customer records. Personal data of government officials and public figures was found among a sample of 100 thousand records on Telegram.

stories.title: Nike sale del top 100 de las empresas más grandes de EU y el gigante deportivo enfrenta un nuevo escenario

en.title: Nike exits top 100 largest US companies as sports giant faces new scenario
en.summary: Nike has dropped out of the list of America's 100 largest companies due to intensifying competition and significant market decline in one of its key regions.

stories.title: Carlos Slim aumenta la velocidad de Telmex sin subir el precio y modifica estos paquetes de internet

en.title: Carlos Slim increases Telmex speed without raising price and modifies internet packages
en.summary: Telmex is offering enhanced internet speeds at unchanged prices, with bundled and standalone internet options available starting at 349 pesos monthly.

stories.title: ¿Quién es el dueño de la Plaza México? El histórico inmueble que cambió los toros por conciertos y espectáculos

en.title: Who owns Plaza México? The historic venue that swapped bullfighting for concerts and shows
en.summary: Plaza México has shifted from its traditional bullfighting purpose toward concerts and entertainment events while remaining a significant historic landmark in the capital.

stories.title: WPP Media va por banca, autos y retail para crecer a doble dígito en México

en.title: WPP Media pursues banking, automotive and retail sectors to achieve double-digit growth in Mexico
en.summary: WPP Media's incoming leadership brings clients including Coca-Cola, Airbnb and Google, while targeting expansion into banking, automotive and retail to drive growth in Mexico.

stories.title: Cómo tener mica de privacidad en tu iPhone sin comprar una: este ajuste lo permite

en.title: How to have a privacy screen on your iPhone without buying one: this setting allows it
en.summary: A setting available on various iPhone generations enables users to obtain a privacy screen without purchasing one, requiring only initial configuration.
